newsitem.title: LEBANON: Swedish embassy reopens in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Swedish embassy reopens in Lebanon.

text.p: Sweden reopened its Beirut embassy on Friday after an 11-year closure due to Lebanon's 1975-1990 civil war, a Swedish official said.

"The main reason for my visit here is the reopening of the Swedish embassy in Beirut," visiting secretary general of the Swedish foreign ministry Yan Eliasson told reporters at the foreign ministry in Beirut.

"It was closed for several years for obvious reasons but we find it very important to establish a physical Swedish presence in Beirut. We think it is absolutely important for a number of reasons to develop our relations in all fields," Eliasson added.
Eliasson, who arrived in Beirut on Friday on a 24-hour visit will hold discussions with Lebanese officials.
